## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes.
- [ ] After a GraphQL change, I ran `pnpm schema` and committed the generated files.
- [ ] Every new GraphQL type and field has a description.
- [ ] I updated the README or `docs/` where the behavior changed.
- [ ] The change has no private or copyrighted story data.
